# Kamayega Bharat - Local Employment & Talent Marketplace
**Developer:** Sourav Bagchi  
**License:** MIT License (https://github.com/kamayegabharat/kamayegabharat.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE)  
**Repository:** https://github.com/kamayegabharat/kamayegabharat.github.io

> A high-performance, dual-sided job platform built to connect local talent with verified employers in India, featuring real-time data synchronization and professional verification.

Kamayega Bharat is an advanced, independent recruitment ecosystem developed to bridge the gap between job seekers and employers. The platform utilizes Firebase for real-time messaging and status updates, ensuring a seamless experience for users across India. It features a unique verification system for companies to establish trust.

## Open Source & Contribution
Kamayega Bharat is an open-source project. We encourage community contributions, transparency, and collaborative improvement. Please review our GitHub Repository for development documentation and contribution guidelines.

## Project Mission
To empower the Indian workforce by providing a fast, secure, and transparent bridge between skill and opportunity, aligned with national digital growth initiatives.
